notes.title: Here comes the Placebo Effect 1.2 update release
notes.content:
The Placebo Effect 1.2 update release is ready! It has been an exciting first month since our initial release, and we really appreciate everyone who has purchased and played the game. We thank you for all of your feedback! We have listened to our fans' great suggestions and made a bunch of updates to make Placebo Effect an even better game!

Updates include:

     Ship speed is faster and now has turbo boost
     Player can no longer run out of ammo
     Optimized enemy count and placement
     Updated "Time" Meter and added a countdown clock
     Improved Enemy AI 
     New and improved soundtrack
     General bug fixes


Thank you for playing and have fun!

Thumbnails below show the Shotbot flying with turbo boost, the time meter with clock, turbo boost meter and new enemy AI.

The Beta Playtest 2.0 for Placebo Effect is now in progress and we are listening to your feedback! 

The game's fast-paced shooter action just got even better because we've added more precision and speed to the Shotbot! It's time to play Placebo Effect again to try out the new gameplay and let us know what you think!

Add Placebo Effect to your Wishlist and sign up on our website for more news about the Game and Trading Cards!

notes.title: Placebo Effect Beta Playtest!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32354939/df405ec89d4c9821dd53710ae224ce0ee5ebd751.png			

Welcome to the Placebo Effect Beta Playtest!			 
				Hello Shotbot Pilots,

With much anticipation, we’re pleased to announce that the Beta playtest for Placebo Effect is now in progress! 

Placebo Effect is a Star Fox inspired third person "space-type" shooter. The gameplay is heavily inspired by classic video games of the past such as fast-paced flying action like Star Fox, puzzle solving like Super Mario 64, item gathering and adventure elements like The Legend of Zelda and King's Quest, but all used in a new way. 

The full game will feature the entire Red Stage made of four unique Phases that must be explored to defeat pathogenic and biohazardous invaders. Your journey will include parts of the body like the intestines, and kidneys while you battle enemies such as Scorpio, Turbo Ticks, The Sporanator, and an army of Bugbots!

The Beta is Phase 1 of the Red Stage and does not include all of the props, puzzles and characters in the entire Stage. If this Stage is well received, then we plan to make more. We will be emailing out the new keys in the next few days and we look forward to hearing about what you like, dislike and want to see. The response has been overwhelming! We appreciate your enthusiasm!

Add Placebo Effect to your Wishlist and sign up on our website for more news about the Game and Trading Cards!
